answer: An agent registers by locking a non-fungible token locked as collateral as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. The fault is proven by spot-checks against the chain when an agent is caught vouching for a transaction without checking it. Proof triggers the penalty: the offender must re-bond at double the amount to return. Every identity carries a crystal deposit, visible and slashable. A delta that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. A zenith that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
